The wait between the first two seasons of Severance has been long, and the third season requires just as much patience – but Apple TV+ has just dropped a noteworthy update about the show's progress.

Severance season 3 has officially started filming, and is expected to air at the end of 2027

It's been roughly 18 months since Severance season 2 aired. While the progress of season 3 might not be as swift as fans would like, it's just hit a major milestone.

According to a post shared by Ben Stiller on X, and reposted by the Apple TV+ account, Severance season 3 has officially started filming.

A low-resolution production photo shared by Stiller appears to show Mark Scout and Helly R. running through the corridors of Lumon, which evokes the events of the season 2 finale.

The season 2 finale ended with Mark making the shocking decision to stay with Helly, rebelling against his outie's plan to reunite with Gemma, setting up what will undoubtedly be a gripping series of events for season 3.

There was a three-year gap between Severance seasons 1 and 2 due to factors including script rewrites, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If season 3 takes six to nine months to film, plus another roughly six months for post-production, we could see Severance return in autumn 2027, just a few months shy of a three-year gap.

When do you expect Severance season 3 to premiere? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, with discounts available via Apple One bundles.
